root.label: Iceland referendum rejects restarting EU accession talks

events.label: Iceland referendum rejects restarting EU accession talks

slots.name: No vote share
slots.sentence: In a vote held Saturday, 52.8 percent of Icelanders rejected the resumption of EU entry talks suspended 13 years ago, while 47.2 percent voted 'Yes', according to the official tally published by RUV, the public broadcaster.

slots.name: Iceland population
slots.sentence: The capital, Reykjavik, was the only area in the island nation of 400,000 people to support the referendum.

slots.name: Eligible voters
slots.sentence: Some 270,000 Icelanders were eligible to vote.

slots.name: Referendum outcome
slots.sentence: Les Islandais ont rejeté dimanche la proposition d'une reprise des négociations d'adhésion à l'Union européenne (UE) à l'issue du référendum organisé samedi,
